quarterly_data.signal: Consolidated Q1 (three months to June 30, 2026): net sales JPY 110,373 million (+7.3%), operating profit JPY 7,132 million (+28.1%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 3,072 million (+95.3%), with steady MLCC release film and COSMOSHINE SRF sales cited. Forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (first announced with these results; previously undecided because of the Middle East situation): net sales JPY 435,000 million (+3.2%), operating profit JPY 23,000 million (-17.6%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 7,000 million (-37.4%).
